summary: PodpisOFF (SubOFF) is a Spring Boot 3.4 + React 19 monolith for tracking subscriptions, reminders, and spend analytics. Traffic enters via Caddy→nginx (prod) or Vite proxy (dev) into a JWT-secured REST API on :8080 backed by PostgreSQL 16 + Flyway. Payments are stubbed (mock YooKassa URL); reminder delivery has no scheduler yet — only Telegram polling is scheduled.

groups.label: Clients
groups.blurb: Browser PWA and Telegram users that hit the product surface.

groups.label: Edge / Ingress
groups.blurb: TLS termination and reverse proxies that serve static assets and /api.

groups.label: Application
groups.blurb: Single Spring Boot process: auth, subscriptions, dashboard, notifications, Telegram, admin.

groups.label: Billing
groups.blurb: Plan catalog and create-payment stub; real YooKassa HTTP not implemented.

groups.label: Datastores
groups.blurb: PostgreSQL is the system of record (JPA + Flyway V1–V14).

groups.label: External SaaS
groups.blurb: Third-party APIs the code actually calls or configures.

nodes.label: Web PWA (SPA)
nodes.detail: React Router app with manual service worker (sw.js) and manifest; calls relative /api via fetch.

nodes.label: Telegram user
nodes.detail: End users interact with PodpisOFF_bot after account linking via deep-link tokens.

nodes.label: Caddy
nodes.detail: Prod edge on podpisoff.ru / www — reverse_proxies to frontend:80 (TLS via Caddy).

nodes.label: Frontend nginx
nodes.detail: Serves built SPA and proxies location /api/ to backend:8080/api/ (frontend/nginx.conf).

nodes.label: REST API
nodes.detail: PodpisoffBackendApplication monolith exposing /api/** controllers with actuator health on /actuator/health.

nodes.label: Auth + OAuth
nodes.detail: Register/login/recovery-key, math captcha, Yandex OAuth start/callback/ticket; OAuth state held in-process ConcurrentHashMap.

nodes.label: Subscriptions
nodes.detail: Subscription CRUD, month-charge overrides, billing-period math; feeds dashboard summary/analytics.

nodes.label: Reminders
nodes.detail: Reminder entity CRUD with ONCE/MONTHLY/YEARLY schedule helpers — no @Scheduled job fires due reminders.

nodes.label: Notifications
nodes.detail: Persists user_notifications and fans out to Web Push, email (if enabled), and Telegram.

nodes.label: Web Push
nodes.detail: Stores push_subscriptions; PushServiceFacade sends via nl.martijndwars.web-push (keys in app.push.*).

nodes.label: Telegram bot svc
nodes.detail: Webhook POST /api/telegram/webhook or TelegramPollingService @Scheduled(fixedDelay=2000); menus, export, link tokens.

nodes.label: Admin API
nodes.detail: Metrics, user block/plan/delete, feedback reply, test notifications — gated by AdminAccessService.

nodes.label: BillingService
nodes.detail: Returns Free/Pro plan catalog; createPayment requires YOOKASSA_* then returns mock-payments.podpisoff.local URL — no real YooKassa HTTP.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL 16
nodes.detail: Primary store for users, subscriptions, reminders, notifications, push, feedback, OAuth identities, login events, telegram link tokens.

nodes.label: Yandex OAuth
nodes.detail: YandexOAuthClient calls authorize/token and login.yandex.ru/info when client id/secret configured.

nodes.label: Telegram Bot API
nodes.detail: TelegramBotApiClient sends messages/documents; optional webhook registration on startup.

nodes.label: SMTP mail
nodes.detail: EmailNotificationService uses JavaMailSender when mail enabled; default MAIL_ENABLED=false and no spring.mail host in main yml.

nodes.label: ЮKassa
nodes.detail: Shop id/secret read from env; docs defer real integration — webhook endpoint not implemented in BillingController.

productionReadiness.why: createPayment returns mock-payments.podpisoff.local even when credentials are set; no webhook controller.
productionReadiness.nextStep: Implement real YooKassa API + webhook signature verify, or keep credentials empty until ready.

productionReadiness.why: Only TelegramPollingService is @Scheduled; due reminders never auto-fire from a job.
productionReadiness.nextStep: Add a scheduled ReminderDispatch job that fans out via NotificationService.

productionReadiness.why: Default JWT secret, ADMIN_PANEL_KEY, and VAPID keys are committed in application.yml / .env.example.
productionReadiness.nextStep: Require env-only secrets in prod profile; rotate any keys that shipped in git.

productionReadiness.why: OAuthFlowStore and CaptchaService use in-process ConcurrentHashMap — lost on restart, not multi-instance safe.
productionReadiness.nextStep: Move tickets/captcha to Redis or DB with TTL.
Disable springdoc in prod or protect with auth/network policy.

productionReadiness.why: Mail stack present but MAIL_ENABLED defaults false; no spring.mail host in main resources.
productionReadiness.nextStep: Wire SMTP/Resend env and enable in prod when reminders ship.

productionReadiness.why: Prod Caddy only proxies to frontend; nginx proxies /api/ only — /actuator/health is not on the public domain path documented in DEPLOYMENT.md.
productionReadiness.nextStep: Expose a dedicated health route or adjust Caddy/nginx for ops checks.
